subject: maths
title: Position and Directions: Left, Right, Forward and Turns
seo_title: Year 1 Position and Directions Worksheets: Left, Right and Following Directions (Free)
standard_text: Give and follow directions to move people and objects to different locations within a space
meta_desc: Free Year 1 maths worksheets on position and directions: above, below, next to, between, in front of and behind, left and right, moving a robot forward and turning on a grid, finding the way to the sandpit on a playground map, and quarter and half turns. 100 picture questions with an answer key, following the Australian Curriculum.
key_big: Turn first, then go forward. Count the moves, not the square you start on.
key_sub: Left is the side of your left hand and right is the side of your right hand. A quarter turn faces the side; a half turn faces the opposite way.
body_html:
Where is it?

Position words tell us where something is.

Between means in the middle of two things.

Left and right

Left is the side of your left hand. Right is the side of your right hand.

Follow directions

A robot moves forward the way its arrow points. Turn right or turn left first, then move.

Count the moves, not the square you start on.

Which way to the sandpit?

Quarter and half turns

A quarter turn makes you face the side. A half turn makes you face the opposite way. A whole turn brings you back.

Example 1

Ava faces the oval. She makes a half turn. What does she face now?

A half turn makes her face the opposite way. The library is opposite the oval.

Answer: the library

Example 2

Mia is 2 squares to the left of the slide. Which way does she go?

Count the moves: 1, 2. Do not count her own square.

Answer: 2 squares right

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up left and rightHold up your hands. Your left hand makes an L shape
Counting the start squareCount the moves: 1, 2, 3 …
Moving before turningTurn first, then go forward
Saying on when it is aboveOn touches. Above has a gap
Mixing up a quarter turn and a half turnQuarter turn: face the side. Half turn: face the opposite way

faq.q: What do Year 1 students learn about position and direction in the Australian Curriculum?
faq.a: In Year 1 (AC9M1SP02) students give and follow directions to move people and objects around a space. They use words like above, below, next to, between, in front of, behind, left, right, forward and turn.

faq.q: How can I help my child learn left and right?
faq.a: Hold up both hands, fingers up and thumbs out. The left hand makes an L shape. Play “touch your left ear” and say left and right on the walk to school.

faq.q: What are good direction games for Year 1?
faq.a: Play “robot”: one child gives directions like “2 steps forward, turn right” and the other follows. A treasure hunt to the sandpit or the canteen works well too.

faq.q: Why does my child get one square too many?
faq.a: Many children count the square they start on. Show them to count each move instead: touch the next square and say 1, then 2, and so on.

sets.title: Above, below, next to, between, in front of, behind

items.q: Where is the koala?
items.e: The koala is on the table. It touches the table top. Above would have a gap.

items.q: Where is the ball?
items.e: The ball is under the table. It is below the table top.

items.q: Where is the balloon?
items.e: The balloon is above the table. It is higher than the table, with a gap. It does not touch the table, so it is not on it.

items.q: Where is the duck?
items.e: The duck is next to the table. It is at the side, close by.

items.q: Where is the teddy?
items.e: The teddy is on the table. It touches the table top. Above would have a gap.

items.q: Where is the cat?
items.e: The cat is under the table. It is below the table top.

items.q: Where is the koala?
items.e: The box hides part of the koala. The koala is further back. It is behind the box.

items.q: Where is the ball?
items.e: We can see all of the ball. It is closer to us than the box. It is in front of the box.

items.q: Where is the teddy?
items.e: We can see all of the teddy. It is closer to us than the box. It is in front of the box.

items.q: Where is the duck?
items.e: The box hides part of the duck. The duck is further back. It is behind the box.

items.q: What is between the teddy and the ball?
items.e: Between means in the middle. The koala is in the middle.

items.q: What is between the duck and the car?
items.e: Find the duck and the car. The apple is in the middle of them.

items.q: Where is the book?
c: between the cat and the duck
items.e: The cat is on one side. The duck is on the other side. The book is between them.

items.q: What is just above the koala?
items.e: Look up from the koala. The star is on the shelf above. The cat is below.

items.q: What is just below the star?
items.e: Look down from the star. The koala is on the shelf below. The car is above.

items.q: Where is the apple?
items.e: The apple is on the top shelf. The teddy is on the shelf under it. The apple is above the teddy.

items.q: Where is the star?
items.e: The star is on the bottom shelf. The duck is on the shelf over it. The star is below the duck.

items.q: Which picture shows the duck under the table?
items.e: Picture C. The duck is below the table top. In one picture a ball is under the table, not the duck.

items.q: Which picture shows the koala behind the box?
items.e: Picture D. The box hides part of the koala. So the koala is behind the box.

items.q: Which picture shows the balloon above the table?
items.e: Picture A. The balloon is higher than the table. There is a gap.

items.q: Which toy is at the left end?
items.e: Left is the side of your left hand. The koala is at the left end.

items.q: Which toy is at the right end?
items.e: Right is the side of your right hand. The cat is at the right end.

items.q: Which toy is at the right end?
items.e: Right is the side of your right hand. The ball is at the right end. The duck is at the left end.

items.q: Which toy is at the left end?
items.e: Left is the side of your left hand. The car is at the left end.

items.q: Which toy is 2nd from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count 1, 2: the teddy, the duck. The 2nd toy is the duck.

items.q: Which toy is 2nd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count 1, 2: the book, the duck. The 2nd toy is the duck.

items.q: Which toy is 3rd from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count 1, 2, 3: the ball, the koala, the star. The 3rd toy is the star.

items.q: Which toy is 3rd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count 1, 2, 3: the star, the koala, the apple. The 3rd toy is the apple.

items.q: Which toy is 4th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count 1, 2, 3, 4: the cat, the teddy, the apple, the ball. The 4th toy is the ball.

items.q: Which toy is 2nd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count 1, 2: the ball, the teddy. The 2nd toy is the teddy.

items.q: What is just to the right of the koala?
items.e: Find the koala. Look to the right side of it. The toy just to the right is the book. The cat is on the other side.

items.q: What is just to the left of the apple?
items.e: Find the apple. Look to the left side of it. The toy just to the left is the car. The teddy is on the other side.

items.q: What is just to the left of the koala?
items.e: Find the koala. Look to the left side of it. The toy just to the left is the teddy. The cat is on the other side.

items.q: What is just to the right of the duck?
items.e: Find the duck. Look to the right side of it. The toy just to the right is the star. The book is on the other side.

items.q: Where is the koala?
c: to the right of the ball
to the left of the ball
items.e: The koala is on the left side of the ball. So it is to the left of the ball.

items.q: Where is the car?
c: to the left of the star
to the right of the star
items.e: The car is on the right side of the star. So it is to the right of the star.

items.q: Where is the cat?
c: to the right of the teddy
to the left of the teddy
items.e: The cat is on the left side of the teddy. So it is to the left of the teddy.

items.q: Which picture shows the koala to the left of the ball?
items.e: Picture B. The koala is on the left side. The ball is on the right side.

items.q: Which picture shows the duck to the right of the star?
items.e: Picture B. The star is on the left side. The duck is on the right side.

items.q: The car is 1st from the left. What is it from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end: duck 1st, apple 2nd, koala 3rd, car 4th.

sets.title: Follow directions on a grid: forward, turn left, turn right

items.q: The robot goes 3 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Forward is the way the red arrow points. Do not count the robot’s own square. Count 1, 2, 3. It stops on the star.

items.q: The robot goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Forward is the way the red arrow points. Do not count the robot’s own square. Count 1, 2. It stops on the cat.

items.q: The robot goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Forward is the way the red arrow points. Do not count the robot’s own square. Count 1, 2. It stops on the duck.

items.q: The robot goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Forward is the way the red arrow points. Do not count the robot’s own square. Count 1, 2. It stops on the apple.

items.q: The robot goes 4 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Forward is the way the red arrow points. Do not count the robot’s own square. Count 1, 2, 3, 4. It stops on the duck.

items.q: The robot goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Forward is the way the red arrow points. Do not count the robot’s own square. Count 1, 2. It stops on the duck.

items.q: How many squares forward to get to the duck?
items.e: Do not count the robot’s own square. Count each move: 1, 2, 3, 4. That is 4.

items.q: How many squares forward to get to the apple?
items.e: Do not count the robot’s own square. Count each move: 1, 2, 3. That is 3.

items.q: How many squares forward to get to the ball?
items.e: Do not count the robot’s own square. Count each move: 1, 2, 3. That is 3.

items.q: The robot turns right. Then it goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Turn first. The robot points up. A right turn makes it point right. Then count 1, 2. It stops on the cat.

items.q: The robot turns left. Then it goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Turn first. The robot points up. A left turn makes it point left. Then count 1, 2. It stops on the koala.

items.q: The robot turns right. Then it goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Turn first. The robot points right. A right turn makes it point down. Then count 1, 2. It stops on the apple.

items.q: The robot turns left. Then it goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Turn first. The robot points right. A left turn makes it point up. Then count 1, 2. It stops on the ball.

items.q: The robot turns right. Then it goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Turn first. The robot points left. A right turn makes it point up. Then count 1, 2. It stops on the duck.

items.q: The robot turns left. Then it goes 3 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: Turn first. The robot points left. A left turn makes it point down. Then count 1, 2, 3. It stops on the apple.

items.q: The robot goes 2 squares forward. It turns left. Then it goes 2 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: It points right, so go 2 squares right first. Turn left: now it points up. Go 2 squares more. It stops on the cat.

items.q: The robot goes 2 squares forward. It turns left. Then it goes 3 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: It points down, so go 2 squares down first. Turn left: now it points right. Go 3 squares more. It stops on the star.

items.q: The robot goes 1 square forward. It turns left. Then it goes 3 squares forward. Where does it stop?
items.e: It points up, so go 1 square up first. Turn left: now it points left. Go 3 squares more. It stops on the ball.

items.q: The robot points up. It turns right. Which way does it point now?
items.e: A right turn goes the same way as clock hands. From up, it now points right.

items.q: The robot points right. It turns right. Which way does it point now?
items.e: A right turn goes the same way as clock hands. From right, it now points down.

sets.title: Which way to the sandpit? Directions on a playground map

items.q: Which way does Mia go to get to the sandpit?
items.e: Go down. Do not count Mia’s own square. Count 1, 2. That is 2 squares down.

items.q: Which way does Jack go to get to the cubby?
items.e: Go right. Do not count Jack’s own square. Count 1, 2, 3. That is 3 squares right.

items.q: Which way does Ava go to get to the tap?
items.e: Go down. Do not count Ava’s own square. Count 1, 2. That is 2 squares down.

items.q: Which way does Leo go to get to the slide?
items.e: Go right. Do not count Leo’s own square. Count 1, 2. That is 2 squares right.

items.q: Which way does Isla go to get to the sandpit?
items.e: Go left. Do not count Isla’s own square. Count 1. That is 1 square left.

items.q: Which way does Kai go to get to the sandpit?
items.e: First go 2 squares right. Then go 1 square down. Count moves, not Kai’s own square.

items.q: Which way does Ruby go to get to the slide?
items.e: First go 3 squares right. Then go 1 square up. Count moves, not Ruby’s own square.

items.q: Which way does Noah go to get to the tree?
items.e: First go 4 squares left. Then go 1 square up. Count moves, not Noah’s own square.

items.q: Which way does Zara go to get to the tap?
items.e: First go 3 squares right. Then go 1 square down. Count moves, not Zara’s own square.

items.q: Which way does Liam go to get to the gate?
items.e: First go 3 squares left. Then go 1 square down. Count moves, not Liam’s own square.

items.q: Mia goes 1 square left, then 1 square up. Where is she now?
items.e: Go 1 square left then 1 square up. Mia gets to the tree.

items.q: Jack goes 2 squares right, then 1 square down. Where is he now?
items.e: Go 2 squares right then 1 square down. Jack gets to the tap.

items.q: Ava goes 1 square up, then 1 square right. Where is she now?
items.e: Go 1 square up then 1 square right. Ava gets to the swings.

items.q: Leo goes 2 squares right. Where is he now?
items.e: Go 2 squares right. Leo gets to the cubby.

items.q: Isla goes 1 square left. Where is she now?
items.e: Go 1 square left. Isla gets to the slide.

items.q: What is just to the left of the bin?
items.e: Look at the bin. The square on its left side has the tap. The cubby is above the bin.

items.q: What is just above the bin?
items.e: Look up from the bin. The cubby is in the square above it.

items.q: What is in the top right corner?
items.e: Top is the top row. Right is the side of your right hand. The swings are there. The tree is top left.

items.q: How many squares does Ava move to the right to get to the cubby?
items.e: Do not count Ava’s own square. Count 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. That is 5 squares.

items.q: How many squares does Leo move to the right to get to the sandpit?
items.e: The sandpit is in the very next square. That is 1 square.

items.q: Ava faces the oval. She makes a quarter turn right. What does she face now?
items.e: Stand like Ava and turn to your right. From the oval, a quarter turn right faces the canteen. Turning the other way would face the gate.

items.q: Leo faces the canteen. He makes a quarter turn left. What does he face now?
items.e: Stand like Leo and turn to your left. From the canteen, a quarter turn left faces the oval. Turning the other way would face the library.

items.q: Isla faces the oval. She makes a half turn. What does she face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. Opposite the oval is the library.

items.q: Noah faces the gate. He makes a quarter turn right. What does he face now?
items.e: Stand like Noah and turn to your right. From the gate, a quarter turn right faces the oval. Turning the other way would face the library.

items.q: Mia faces the oval. She turns to face the canteen. What turn is that?
items.e: The canteen is on the right side. Turning to face it is a quarter turn right.

items.q: Kai faces the oval. He turns to face the gate. What turn is that?
items.e: The gate is on the left side. Turning to face it is a quarter turn left.

items.q: Chloe faces the canteen. She turns to face the gate. What turn is that?
items.e: The gate is the opposite way. Turning to face it is a half turn.

items.q: How many quarter turns make a half turn?
items.e: A quarter turn, then another quarter turn, makes a half turn. That is 2.

items.q: Liam makes a quarter turn right. Then he makes another quarter turn right. What is that the same as?
items.e: 2 quarter turns make a half turn. Liam now faces the opposite way.

items.q: The children line up at the canteen door. Who is just behind Leo?
items.e: Behind Leo means further from the door. That is Mia. Ava is in front of Leo.

items.q: Who is just in front of Kai?
items.e: In front of Kai means closer to the door. That is Mia. Ruby is behind Kai.

items.q: How many children are in front of Mia?
items.e: Ava and Leo are in front of Mia. That is 2. Do not count Mia.

items.q: Oliver faces the board. He makes a half turn. What does he face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. Opposite the board is the window.

items.q: Grace faces the door. She makes a quarter turn left. What does she face now?
items.e: Stand like Grace and turn to your left. From the door, she faces the board. A right turn would face the window.

items.q: Ruby faces the oval. She makes a whole turn. What does she face now?
items.e: A whole turn goes all the way round. Ruby faces the oval again.

items.q: Who sits just to the right of Jack?
items.e: Find Jack. Look to the right side. Mei is next. Isla is on Jack’s left side.

items.q: Who sits between Mei and Zara?
items.e: Mei is on one side. Zara is on the other side. Noah is in the middle.

items.q: Where does Isla sit?
items.e: Isla is the first child on the left side. She sits at the left end.

items.q: Kai takes 3 steps forward. Then he takes 3 steps back. Where is he now?
items.e: 3 steps forward and 3 steps back cancel out. Kai is back where he started.

items.q: Zara stands in front of Leo in a line. Where is Leo?
items.e: If Zara is in front of Leo, then Leo is behind Zara.
